_texte.Ce se întâmplă dacă niciun asigurator nu: What happens if no insurer confirms the request?
_texte.Clientul poate selecta asigurare extinsă: The customer can select extended insurance directly at checkout. Higher cover, longer terms. The values and conditions are configured by the insurers in the back office.
_texte.Condiții specifice și excluderi per poli: Specific conditions and exclusions per policy
_texte.Cum funcționează garanția dacă lucrarea: How does the warranty work if the work has defects?
_texte.Cât durează decontarea unei daune?: How long does it take to settle a claim?
_texte.Da. Orice produs din marketplace benefic: Yes. Every marketplace product benefits from the legal guarantee (at least 2 years under EU Directive 2019/771) plus the manufacturer's commercial warranty. The digital certificate is issued and archived automatically.
_texte.Documente necesare pentru dosarul de dau: Documents required for the claim file
_texte.Emisă automat la confirmarea lucrării: Issued automatically when the work is confirmed
_texte.Franșize și limite de acoperire per cate: Excesses and cover limits per category
_texte.Garanția standard My Darrin și opțiunile: The standard My Darrin warranty and the extended insurance options for work carried out through the platform.
_texte.Incluse automat sau disponibile la cerer: Included automatically or available on request — every order protected from the moment of payment.
_texte.La cererea clientului · Contra cost: At the customer's request · At extra cost
_texte.Lista asiguratorilor aprobați și priorit: The list of approved insurers and their priority
_texte.Materialele și electrocasnicele din mark: Are marketplace materials and home appliances covered?
_texte.Nicio valoare nu este hardcodată în plat: No value is hard-coded in the platform — everything is configured from the admin panel.
_texte.Obiecte din marketplace My Darrin: Items from the My Darrin marketplace
_texte.Orice serviciu, orice adresă — protejat: Any service, any address — protected automatically from the moment of payment until the warranty expires.
_texte.Partenerul execută lucrarea. PV digital: The partner carries out the work. A digital report with before/after photos and a GPS timestamp, signed and archived automatically.
_texte.Proceduri constatare daune din vina part: Procedures for assessing damage caused by partners
_texte.Reguli de escaladare cu valoarea comenzi: Escalation rules based on order value
_texte.Respectă termenele legale de garanție: Complies with the legal warranty periods
_texte.Sistemul escaladează automat cererea căt: The system automatically escalates the request to the SuperAdmin. The order cannot be completed without an active policy. The customer is notified and can choose another date or cancel at no cost.
_texte.Termene decontare și workflow aprobare d: Settlement deadlines and claims approval workflow
_texte.Valoare crește cu valoarea comenzii: Value increases with the order value
_texte.Valori daune standard și plafonuri maxim: Standard damage values and maximum ceilings
_texte.Clientul plasează comanda și plătește cu: The client places the order and pays by card, through the payment processor, or by bank transfer to Home Best Pal SRL. The amount is held as a guarantee (escrow) until the work is confirmed.
_texte.Clientul confirmă lucrarea sau deschide: The client confirms the work or opens a complaint.
_texte.După confirmarea lucrării, suma păstrată: After the work is confirmed, the amount held as a guarantee is released to the participants, according to the price formula configured in the back office.
_texte.Prețul fiecărei comenzi My Darrin includ: The price of every My Darrin order includes the cost of insurance, and the policies are issued by the partner insurers, with the values and conditions they configure.
_texte.Asigurator partener aprobat în platformă: Partner insurer approved on the platform
_texte.Decontare în termenul din poliță: Settlement within the period in the policy
_texte.Cererea de poliță ajunge la asiguratorii: The policy request reaches the partner insurers approved on the platform, and the policy is issued by the insurer that accepts it.
_texte.Cererea ajunge la asiguratorii parteneri: The request reaches the partner insurers
_texte.Cererea de emitere a poliței se transmit: The request to issue the policy is sent to the partner insurers approved on the platform.
_texte.Polița aferentă serviciului se emite de: The policy for the service is issued by the insurer that accepts the request.
_texte.Dacă lucrarea prezintă defecte în termen: If the work shows defects within the warranty period, the client opens a complaint on the platform. The My Darrin team checks the before/after photos and the documents, establishes responsibility and starts the claims procedure. The partner fixes the defect or bears the cost from the workmanship policy.
_texte.Cum se stabilește plafonul poliței?: How is the policy limit set?
_texte.Plafonul și condițiile fiecărei polițe s: The limit and conditions of each policy are configured by the insurer in the back office. The client can add protection through the extended premium policy.
_texte.Termenul de decontare este cel din condi: The settlement period is the one in the policy conditions. The client is notified by email at every stage.
